title: NaturalSpeech 3: Zero-Shot Speech Synthesis with Factorized Codec and Diffusion Models

layout.note: Two vertical tracks, both read bottom-up. On the left a tinted container holds a stack of five equal-width module boxes joined by up arrows; on the right a Codec Encoder, a dashed code slot with the timbre embedding, and a Codec Decoder are chained. Three lines from the top three diffusion boxes merge into a single arrow that enters the dashed slot, tying the two tracks together; a three-row legend sits above the left track.

lesson: Draw a system with two sub-models as two parallel bottom-up columns: a tinted container holding a stack of equal-width, differently tinted modules, and a plain encoder-to-decoder column, meeting in one dashed rounded slot for the shared codes; define the symbols in a three-row legend.
